hero.subtitle: Authentic Mexican food made with love, flavor, and tradition.

about.subtitle: About us
about.description: Sabores was born from a love of traditional Mexican cuisine. From fresh guacamole to homemade weekend burritos, our commitment is to deliver authentic flavors, served with heart.
about.why_description: At Sabores, we bring the most traditional flavors of Mexico. From handmade tacos to weekend barbacoa, each dish is prepared with fresh ingredients, homemade seasoning, and a touch of love.
about.why_soul: It's not just fast food, it's food with soul!

barbacoa.subtitle: Mexican Weekend
barbacoa.description: Enjoy our Hidalgo-style barbacoa: tender meat, handmade tortillas, onion, cilantro, and a piping hot broth.
barbacoa.phrase: A flavor that is not forgotten and is served with love.

menu.title: Menu
menu.cat_tacos_desc: Each taco is served on a fresh, handmade corn tortilla with your choice of filling. Choose from our slow-cooked stews (cazuelas) or freshly grilled meats (parrilla).
menu.cat_kilo_desc: Take your favorite filling home by the kilo! Perfect for family gatherings, parties, or meal prep. Everything comes with sides to assemble your own tacos.
menu.cat_bebidas_desc: Traditional Mexican beverages made fresh in-house with natural ingredients.
menu.sub_cazuelas_desc: Traditional stews slow-cooked in clay pots, served on a handmade corn tortilla. Think of it as a soft taco with a home-style stew filling.
menu.sub_cazuelas_includes: Each taco includes: Mexican rice, refried beans, and salsa on the side.
menu.sub_parrilla_desc: Freshly grilled meats cooked to order, served on a large 16cm tortilla with fresh toppings to build your own taco.
menu.sub_parrilla_includes: Each taco includes: Large tortilla (16 cm), fresh cilantro, diced onion, salsas, and lime wedges.
menu.sub_guisados_kilo_desc: The same delicious cazuela stews, available to take home by the kilo.
menu.sub_guisados_kilo_includes: Includes: Mexican rice, refried beans, warm tortillas, and salsa.
menu.sub_carne_tacos_kilo_desc: Grilled meats ready to take home by the kilo.
menu.sub_carne_kilo_includes: Includes: Tortillas (16 cm), fresh cilantro, diced onion, salsas, and lime wedges.
menu.item_pozole_desc: A rich, hearty broth with large corn kernels (hominy) and tender pork. Served with shredded lettuce, radish, onion, oregano, cilantro, lime, and our crunchy homemade tostadas to crumble on top.
menu.item_volcanes_desc: A crispy corn tortilla topped with a thick layer of bubbly melted cheese, your choice of meat, diced onion, cilantro, and salsa. Named 'volcanes' because the cheese bubbles like lava!
menu.item_empanadas_desc: A corn tortilla folded in half and fried golden crispy, stuffed with your choice of meat. Served topped with shredded lettuce, crumbled cheese, Mexican cream, and salsa.
menu.item_tostadas_desc: A flat, crunchy fried corn tortilla piled with your choice of meat, shredded lettuce, cheese, Mexican cream, and salsas. Eaten with your hands like a Mexican-style open-faced sandwich.
menu.item_agua_sabor_desc: Fresh seasonal fruit blended with water and a touch of sugar. Light, refreshing, and made fresh daily. Flavors change with the season.
menu.item_agua_natural_desc: Purified bottled water, cold and refreshing.
menu.item_refrescos_desc: Ask about our selection — we carry popular Mexican sodas and classic flavors.
menu.item_cafe_olla_desc: Traditional Mexican coffee brewed in a clay pot with cinnamon, piloncillo (raw cane sugar), and a hint of clove. Sweet, warm, and aromatic.
menu.item_tinga_desc: Hand-shredded chicken slow-simmered in a smoky chipotle-tomato sauce with caramelized onions. Mildly spicy with a deep, smoky flavor that's totally addictive.
menu.item_cerdo_adobado_desc: Pork slow-cooked in a rich adobo sauce made with dried ancho and guajillo chilies, then pressed on the griddle until golden and crispy outside, tender inside.
menu.item_carnitas_desc: Chunks of pork slow-cooked for hours in a copper pot in their own fat until fall-apart tender, juicy inside with golden crispy edges. Michoacán style.
menu.item_chicharron: Chicharrón in Salsa (Pork Rinds in Sauce)
menu.item_chicharron_desc: Crispy fried pork skin (similar to pork cracklings) simmered in our homemade green or red salsa until they become soft and soak up all the delicious flavor.
menu.item_bistec_nopales_desc: Seared beef strips with tender cactus paddles (nopales — they have a mild, fresh flavor similar to green beans), jalapeño peppers, onion, and tomato.
menu.item_papa_chorizo_desc: Golden diced potatoes sautéed with Mexican chorizo — a red, crumbly pork sausage spiced with paprika and chilies. The chorizo releases its red-spiced oil and coats every potato bite.
menu.item_papa_carne_desc: Diced potatoes stewed with seasoned ground beef, cumin, garlic, onion, and aromatic herbs. A hearty, comforting home-style stew.
menu.item_migas_desc: The golden, crunchy little pieces that settle at the bottom of the carnitas pot during cooking. Pure concentrated pork flavor — crispy, rich, and the best part of the carnitas.
menu.item_pastor_desc: Pork marinated in achiote (a red seed spice), dried chilies, and spices, stacked on a vertical spit that rotates next to an open flame. Sliced thin and served with grilled pineapple. Mexico's #1 taco.
menu.item_chorizo_desc: A crumbly Mexican pork sausage made with guajillo chili, paprika, garlic, and spices. Grilled and broken apart on the flat-top. Deep red color with a bold, spiced kick.
menu.item_bistec_desc: Thin-cut beef seasoned with salt, pepper, and garlic, seared on a hot grill. Juicy and tender with a smoky char. Chopped into pieces for the taco.
menu.item_campechano_desc: The fan-favorite combo: chopped grilled steak, crumbled chorizo, and crispy chicharrón bits — all from the grill, mixed together. For those who can't pick just one.
